studies.finding: In synaptic blockers ON cells hyperpolarize (to -65.5 mV) and stop spiking, whereas OFF transient and OFF sustained cells depolarize (to about -55 mV) and fire more regularly (20.3 and 43.3 Hz), showing intrinsic spontaneous activity. TTX at 0.1 micromolar abolishes fast spikes first, then subthreshold oscillations, and hyperpolarizes the cells by about 3-5 mV.
limitations: TTX blocks voltage-gated Na+ channels; the Na+ concentration gradient itself is not removed.

studies.finding: Loss of the endogenous IL-1 inhibitor produces joint-restricted chronic inflammation. On the BALB/cA background the first signs appear at 5 weeks, over 80 percent of mutants are arthritic before 8 weeks and all are arthritic by 13 weeks, whereas no wild-type or heterozygous littermate develops arthritis. Histology of the ankle joints shows marked synovial and periarticular inflammation with proliferating synovial lining cells, pannus formation, neutrophil and lymphocyte invasion, fibrin clots in the synovial space and articular and bone erosion with activated osteoclasts, and no other histopathological abnormality is found. In arthritic joints at 16 weeks IL-1beta transcripts rise about 10-fold, IL-6 10 to 26-fold, TNF-alpha 1.2 to 1.5-fold, COX-2 2.5 to 3.5-fold and both IL-1 receptors about 2-fold, while IL-1alpha falls. The same mediators are already elevated in non-arthritic joints at 4 weeks and at 10 to 12 weeks, which the source reads as low normal IL-1 levels inducing inflammatory genes once the antagonist is absent. None of the mutants on the C57BL/6J background is arthritic at 16 weeks, so a further genetic factor is required.
limitations: One tissue, the joint, in one knockout; whether other tissue inflammatory microenvironments depend on the same cytokine set-point is not tested.
The phenotype is strain-dependent and absent on a C57BL/6J background at 16 weeks, so the shifted cytokine baseline is not sufficient on its own.
Autoantibodies against immunoglobulin G, type II collagen and double-stranded DNA also rise, so an adaptive contribution is not excluded.
Joint mediator levels are Northern-blot transcript measurements on pooled joint tissue without protein or spatially resolved data.

studies.finding: Senescent cells, present in lesions but not in adjacent normal vasculature or in low-fat-diet aortas, are efficiently cleared by ganciclovir in p16-3MR mice. Clearance during 88 days of feeding lowers plaque burden by about 60 percent through fewer and smaller plaques. In 9-day fatty streaks, which are highly SA beta-Gal positive and consist of foam-cell macrophages, clearance reduces streak size and multilayered foci, and three days of clearance in established 12-day streaks sharply reduces transcripts of p16Ink4a and of the SASP components Mmp3, Mmp13, Il1alpha and Tnfalpha together with the monocyte-recruitment factors Mcp1 and Vcam1. In established plaques, clearance over 100 days reduces inflammatory cytokine and monocyte-recruitment expression and the metalloproteases Mmp3, Mmp12 and Mmp13 regardless of diet, preserves fibrous-cap thickness and collagen, reduces elastic-fibre disruption and reduces monocyte attachment to plaque-adjacent endothelium. Sorted p16-positive plaque cells express Il1alpha, Tnfalpha, Mmp3, Mmp12, Mmp13, Mcp1 and Vcam1, with Il1alpha, Mmp12, Mmp13 and Mcp1 markedly enriched over p16-negative cells, whereas Mmp3, Tnfalpha and Vcam1 are not enriched although they fall with senolysis.
limitations: One lesion type in one hyperlipidaemic mouse model; the inflammatory microenvironments of other tissues are not tested.
p16-3MR killing removes p16-positive cells of three morphological classes rather than the secretory phenotype alone, so the secretory output and the cells are not separated.
Mmp3, Tnfalpha and Vcam1 fall with senolysis without being enriched in p16-positive cells, which the source attributes to indirect effects.
Transcript measurements are tissue-level averages; the spatial partitioning of the microenvironment is shown histologically rather than by spatially resolved expression.
studies.observable: Plaque burden, number and size, fatty-streak size and foam-cell multilayers, fibrous-cap thickness and elastic-fibre integrity, and aortic-arch transcript levels of inflammatory cytokines, monocyte-recruitment factors and metalloproteases
studies.preparation: Feed 10-week-old Ldlr-null and Ldlr-null;p16-3MR mice a high-fat diet and give ganciclovir or vehicle to kill p16-positive cells, with ganciclovir-treated Ldlr-null mice as a transgene-free control. Three regimens are used: ganciclovir throughout 88 days of high-fat feeding; daily or three-times-daily ganciclovir during or after 9 to 12 days of feeding, when only inner-curvature fatty streaks exist; and 100 days of cyclical ganciclovir after 88 days of feeding, on a continued high-fat or a reverted low-fat diet. Clearance is verified by SA beta-Gal staining, electron microscopy of X-Gal crystals and senescence-marker transcripts. Lesion-bearing Ldlr-null;ATTAC tissue is separately sorted into p16-driven GFP-positive and GFP-negative cells.
